title: Qualify the three physical AC1018 LAYOUT callbacks through AC1024 DXF output

independentReader.scope: Corroborates the source layout identities and graph; does not establish emitted DXF semantics.

formatEvidence.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
relevantRules: The LAYOUT body contains PlotSettings fields and layout-specific fields.
The trailing common handle stream contains the parent handle and reactors; the body also carries the associated paperspace BLOCK_RECORD handle.

The source-version callback frame for AC1018 does not itself carry validated common-link fields, so this profile binds the typed parent/reactor values to the rooted ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD graph.

sourceProfile.namedObjectDictionary: NOD 0x0C has a unique ACAD_LAYOUT entry to dictionary 0x1A.
sourceProfile.boundedFields: All three records have one dictionary reactor; no extension dictionary, XRECORD, EED, application data, data storage, viewport-list entries, plot-view/shade references or UCS references. The typed records carry their own nonzero parent handles and the reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD relation.
sourceProfile.callbackFrames: Three distinct type-82 object frames match the source version and handles. Their legacy common-link evidence is Unknown with parent 0; typed owner/reactor fields are independently checked against the rooted dictionary before admission.

implementation.summary: Extend the existing transactional LAYOUT source/output profile to admit the exact AC1018 three-layout graph when writing AC1024 DXF. Freeze and compare the source version explicitly, use bounded per-layout snapshots, and retain the AC1024 frame-common evidence path unchanged. The staged TABLES/OBJECTS inspectors validate the ACAD_LAYOUT root, complete layout fields, mapped owners/reactors and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD links before publishing callback qualification.
implementation.failureAndRetry: For ASCII and Binary, replacing Layout1's source BLOCK_RECORD handle with NoHandle is refused before destination replacement; the seeded destination and all three callback qualification states remain unchanged. Restoring the handle and retrying on the same adapter succeeds, qualifies all three LAYOUT identities, and freshly imports the complete AC1024 DXF layout dictionary and fields.
implementation.styleIsolation: The source also contains invalid non-shape empty-name STYLE 0xDF. The selector changes only its in-memory test name to reach bounded LAYOUT output; the separate STYLE refusal selector remains authoritative. This does not qualify or omit the STYLE row or claim whole-document conversion.

qualification.strictWholeSource: Still refuses at 13/23. The remaining identities are listed in the updated plan; the invalid STYLE remains separately fail-closed.
